Alif Laam Meem
Beshak is kitaab ki tanzeel aalameen ke Parwardigar ki taraf se hai

Kya un logon ka kehna yeh hai ke yeh rasool ka iftira hai? Hargiz nahin, yeh aap ke Parwardigar ki taraf se barhaq hai taake aap us qaum ko daraayein jis ki taraf aap se pehle koi daraane waala rasool nahin aaya hai, ke shaayad yeh hidaayat-yaafta ho jaayein

Allah hi woh hai jis ne aasmaan o zameen aur us ki tamaam darmiyaani makhlooqaat ko chhe din ke andar paida kiya hai, aur us ke baad Arsh par apna iqtidaar qaaim kiya hai, aur tumhaare liye us ko chhod kar koi sarparast ya sifaarish karne waala nahin hai. Kya tumhaari samajh mein yeh baat nahin aa rahi hai
Woh Khuda aasmaan se zameen tak ke umoor ki tadbeer karta hai, phir yeh amr us ki baargaah mein us din pesh hoga jis ki miqdaar tumhaare hisaab ke mutaabiq hazaar saal ke baraabar hogi
Woh Khuda haazir o ghaaib sab ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-izzat o meharbaan hai
Us ne har cheez ko husn ke saath banaaya hai, aur insaan ki khilqat ka aaghaaz mitti se kiya hai
Us ke baad us ki nasl ko ek zaleel paani se qaraar diya hai
Us ke baad use baraabar kar ke us mein apni rooh phoonk di hai, aur tumhaare liye kaan, aankh aur dil bana diye hain, magar tum bahut kam shukriya ada karte ho
Aur yeh kehte hain ke agar hum zameen mein gum ho gaye to kya nayi khilqat mein phir zaahir kiye jaayenge? Baat yeh hai ke yeh apne Parwardigar ki mulaaqaat ke munkir hain
Aap keh dijiye ke tum ko woh Malak-ul-Maut zindagi ki aakhri manzil tak pahunchaaega jo tum par ta'ayyunaat kiya gaya hai, us ke baad tum sab Parwardigar ki baargaah mein pesh kiye jaaoge

Aur kaash aap dekhte jab mujrimeen Parwardigar ki baargaah mein sar jhukaaye khade honge (aur kahenge) Parwardigar! Hum ne sab dekh liya aur sun liya, ab humein dobaara waapas kar de ke hum nek amal karein, beshak hum yaqeen karne waalon mein hain
Aur hum chaahte to jabran har nafs ko us ki hidaayat de dete, lekin hamaari taraf se yeh baat tai ho chuki hai ke hum Jahannam ko jinnaat aur tamaam gumraah insaanon se bhar denge

Lihaaza tum log is baat ka maza chakho ke tum ne aaj ke din ki mulaaqaat ko bhula diya tha, to hum ne bhi tum ko nazar-andaaz kar diya hai. Ab apne guzashta aamaal ke badle daaimi azaab ka maza chakho

Hamaari aayaton par imaan laane waale afraad bas woh hain jinhein aayaat ki yaad dilaayi jaati hai to sajde mein gir padte hain aur apne Rab ki hamd o sana ki tasbeeh karte hain aur takabbur nahin karte hain
Un ke pehlu bistar se alag rehte hain, aur woh apne Parwardigar ko khauf aur tama' ki buniyaad par pukaarte rehte hain, aur hamaare diye hue rizq se hamaari raah mein infaaq karte rehte hain
Pas kisi nafs ko nahin maaloom hai ke us ke liye kya kya khunaki-e-chashm ka saamaan chhupa kar rakha gaya hai, jo un ke aamaal ki jaza hai
Kya woh shakhs jo saahib-e-imaan hai us ke misl ho jaaega jo faasiq hai? Hargiz nahin, dono baraabar nahin ho sakte
Jo log imaan laaye hain aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hain un ke liye aaraam karne ki jannatein hain jo un ke aamaal ki jaza hain

Aur jin logon ne fisq ikhtiyaar kiya hai un ka thikaana Jahannam hai, ke jab us se nikalne ka iraada karenge to dobaara palta diye jaayenge, aur kaha jaaega ke us Jahannam ki aag ka maza chakho jis ka tum inkaar kiya karte the
Aur hum yaqeenan bade azaab se pehle inhein ma'mooli azaab ka maza chakhaayenge ke shaayad isi tarah raah-e-raast par palat aayein
Aur us se bada zaalim kaun hai jise aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ki yaad dilaayi jaaye aur phir us se e'raaz kare? To hum yaqeenan mujrimeen se intiqaam lene waale hain

Aur hum ne Moosa alaihis-salaam ko bhi kitaab ata ki hai, lihaaza aap ko apne Quran ke minjaanib-Allah hone mein shak nahin hona chaahiye, aur hum ne kitaab-e-Moosa ko Bani Israaeel ke liye hidaayat qaraar diya hai
Aur hum ne un mein se kuch logon ko imaam aur peshwa qaraar diya hai jo hamaare amr se logon ki hidaayat karte hain, is liye ke unhon ne sabr kiya hai aur hamaari aayaton par yaqeen rakhte the
Beshak aap ka Parwardigar un ke darmiyaan roz-e-qiyaamat un tamaam baaton ka faisla kar dega jin mein yeh aapas mein ikhtilaaf rakhte the

To kya un ki hidaayat ke liye yeh kaafi nahin hai ke hum ne un se pehle bahut si qaumon ko halaak kar diya hai jin ki bastiyon mein yeh chal phir rahe hain, aur is mein hamaari bahut si nishaaniyaan hain, to kya yeh sunte nahin hain

Kya un logon ne yeh nahin dekha hai ke hum paani ko chateel maidaan ki taraf baha le jaate hain aur us ke zariye zaraa'at paida karte hain jise yeh khud bhi khaate hain aur un ke jaanwar bhi khaate hain, to kya yeh dekhte nahin hain
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke aakhir woh fatah ka din kab aaega agar aap log sachche hain
To keh dijiye ke fatah ke din phir kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon ka imaan kaam nahin aaega aur na inhein mohlat hi di jaaegi
Lihaaza aap un se kinaara-kash rahein aur waqt ka intezaar karein ke yeh bhi intezaar karne waale hain
